info.title: About Us
info.text: Two soulful sisters bringing the sweet taste of Nigeria to the streets of London. Established in 2017, The Flygerians mix vibrant and colourful Nigerian street food with a modern British twist.

paragraphs: Please inform us if you or anyone has any food allergies and we can adjust the recipe to align/fit your dietary needs.

All prices will be subject to sustainable cutlery, plates and napkins of £100 - unless you remove this option and provide your own. If you require any chinaware, crockery, chaffing dishes or staff at your event please let us know.
We are happy to design a bespoke menu for you from the listing at your suggestions. You can choose your items, based on the package option you want to go for.
For more information do email us on: theflygerians@outlook.com

columns.heading: Profession serving staff
paragraphs: This additional fee is for having professional staff present on the day to serve your food. This is a great feature that means you can focus on enjoying the day and the staff will be on hand to answer any questions and look after your guest. This is a popular choice for many, as we will do the hard work for you portion control and food served with Flygerian love and good vibes. This service will cost £280 and include your chaffing trays.

columns.heading: Food warming chaffing trays
paragraphs: This will ensure your chosen food items are at the perfect temperature for your guest to enjoy your food.
